q.g: The RSP-30 reactive signal cartridge (Special Yellow) provided by Prapor via in-game mail can be used to call in a special airdrop containing a few of the required items. Military electronic items: * Iridium military thermal vision module * Military COFDM Wireless Signal Transmitter * Military cable * Military circuit board * Military gyrotachometer *Military power filter * Virtex programmable processor PC component items: * Bundle of wires * CPU fan * DVD drive * Damaged hard drive * Electronic components * Graphics card * PC CPU * Power cord * Power supply unit * Printed circuit board * RAM stick
